free_tier.stated: First 10GB storage is always free; storage above it is billed per byte-hour at USD 6.95/TB/30-days
free_tier.notes: Class A, B and C API calls are free on pay-as-you-go; Class D calls are free up to 2,500 a day. The API pricing page still prints USD 0.005/GB/month for storage after the first 10 GB, while the pricing page and its billing FAQ print USD 6.95/TB/30-days.

per_object_cap.stated: Large files can range in size from 5 MB to 10 TB; a file sent in one request is limited to 5 GB
per_object_cap.notes: 10 TB is the cap for a large (multipart) file, assembled from parts of 5 MB to 5 GB; the page does not say whether TB is decimal or binary, so bytes is left null.

retention.stated: No minimum storage duration fees; the pages read state no expiry for stored files
retention.notes: the pricing page lists 'No minimum file size or storage duration fees'; lifecycle rules are set per bucket by the account holder.

egress.terms: Free up to 3x the average monthly stored bytes (byte-hours over the billing cycle), then USD 0.01/GB; unlimited and free to partner CDNs and compute services (Fastly, Cloudflare, bunny.net, CacheFly, CoreWeave, Equinix Metal, Vultr, phoenixNAP)
egress.free_allowance: 3x the average monthly stored bytes; unmetered to the named partner CDNs and compute services
egress.price_per_tb: USD 0.01 per GB beyond the 3x allowance

interface_detail: S3-Compatible API (the S3 syntax, with limited ACL and tagging support) and the B2 Native API (b2_* calls)
tooling: AWS CLI, AWS SDKs, AWS Tools for PowerShell and s3cmd against the S3-Compatible API; any S3 client, rclone's s3 backend among them; the B2 Native API for b2_* calls
chaining: An S3 origin behind Cloudflare, Fastly or bunny.net: egress to those partner CDNs is free and outside the 3x allowance, so a CDN-fronted public bucket serves reads without the USD 0.01/GB overage.

limits.value: 10 GB of storage free; every byte above it is billed at USD 6.95/TB/30-days
egress free up to 3x the average monthly stored bytes; beyond it USD 0.01/GB, except to partner CDNs and compute services
10 TB per large file (parts of 5 MB to 5 GB); 5 GB per single-request file
Class D transactions: the first 2,500 calls a day free, then USD 0.004 per 10,000 calls; Class A, B and C calls free

limits_note: No minimum file size and no minimum storage duration fees. A public bucket needs a verified email address and a payment history on file, or a small card payment credited to the account balance.
binding_note: the 10 GB of free storage is the first ceiling; on the paid tier the next one is the 3x-of-stored egress allowance, which partner-CDN egress does not count against

identity_cost.detail: Account creation asks for an email address verified by a link, a password and a data region, and the sign-up page states 'No credit card required.' A public bucket needs a payment history or a small card payment. A help-centre article says enabling B2 on an existing Computer Backup account prompts for a phone number verified by SMS; the account-creation guide names no phone step.

reliability_note: no throttle, suspension or data-loss event is stated on the pages read; usage above 10 GB of storage or above the 3x egress allowance is billed automatically
confidence_note: every value is quoted from a first-party Backblaze page read on 2026-10-30; no request was made against the service, so the read path is unprobed. A probe of a public object would raise it to measured.
